Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: revised monster source for Project RL, a grim industrial cyberpunk horror roguelike rendered at native 64px tiles.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its recognizable creature identity, main silhouette, anatomy and number of limbs. Input image 2 is ONLY the accepted simplified graphic style reference, not an anatomical or equipment reference. Never copy its cannon arm, respirator, clothes, mechanical parts or pose.
Style: clean bold dark comic outlines, strong large flat colored shapes, ONE main shadow per material. Remove fine scratches, skin mottling, repeated inner muscle lines, gore filigree, many small teeth, dense rib patterns, little folds and polygon patchwork. Mature unsettling original game creature, no cute or heroic treatment. No pink.
Composition: ONE full creature, nearly frontal with slight overhead game camera. ALL limbs, claws and upper tips comfortably inside generous actual ALPHA transparent margins. No floor, shadow, background, halo, active magic, particles, extra figures, text or collage. Static appearance revision only: no combat ability, damage, status, timer, animation, collision or spawning rule.
Subject: the enormous low broad ORGANIC ICE-PLANE BOSS STUDY from image 1. This is the same six-supported fleshy creature, NOT a newly assigned story character or the named final boss. Preserve one huge squat central fleshy mass, a gaping VERTICAL VENTRAL MOUTH, exactly SIX weight-bearing clawed limbs (three on each side), and THREE large dark ice growths projecting from the back.
The three limbs on each side attach separately to the same single central body: front pair nearest viewer, middle pair braced sideways, rear pair visible behind with their clawed supports staggered outward. All SIX limbs must remain legible as separate supports, with clear negative-space channels; no extra dangling arms, tentacles, wings, human torso or separate humanoid head. The creature has no ordinary face or pair of eyes.
Its single long dark ventral mouth is the central focal sign, vertically open with only FOUR large irregular ivory fangs on each side and ONE dark brick-red interior plane. Keep a blunt ivory lip/bone edge; no tiny tooth rows, tongues, gore trails or dripping liquids. Body: broad pale cold PURPLE-GREY folds over charcoal shadow; only THREE or FOUR large flesh folds around mouth. Remove the tiny wrinkled skin lines and two little hanging gland sacs to reduce clutter. Sparse thick ivory bone plates around limb joints; ONE broad bone sheath per limb, THREE blunt dark hooked digits per support, no many spikes or many armor-like segments.
Back: exactly THREE broad asymmetrical DARK BLUE-BLACK ICE SPIRES, one central taller spike and one lower outward spike on each side. Each spire has TWO or THREE large flat facets only, with ONE pale cold-blue edge to read as dark ice. Retain an ivory bony root at base of each spire, but no branching bone lattice. No floating snow, frost aura, sparkling ice particles, icicle fringe or active freezing effect. Flesh, bone, dark ice and mouth should be readable from a few large masses, not a surface covered in texture.
Keep its entire broad low body and all six feet within generous margins. About twice a human's visual mass/height at native scale is intended; the enlarged composition is visual only and does not define occupied gameplay cells.

Edit target: the supplied ice-creature image. Change ONLY the layout and visibility of the SIX supporting legs. Current problem: rear supports overlap the foreground legs, so the count is unclear. Redraw the support arrangement so the viewer can unambiguously count exactly THREE separate clawed legs on the LEFT and THREE on the RIGHT, SIX total, with each complete foot clearly visible.
Make a roughly symmetrical fan of legs around the mouth/body:
- rear pair attaches high at left and right body flanks and reaches outward to the TOPMOST pair of clawed feet, near the body's mid-height;
- middle pair attaches at the middle flanks, reaching farthest outward/down to the MIDDLE pair of clawed feet;
- front pair attaches low/forward, thick legs reaching down toward the BOTTOMMOST pair of feet, closer to the centerline.
All three feet on EACH side must be in clear separate negative spaces, staggered in height. Do NOT stack any rear foot behind a front shin, mouth, or another foot. Each leg is one coherent pale bone/flesh jointed support ending in a small broad claw cluster. No free floating claws, amputated stumps, extra tentacles, arms or more than six limbs. Keep all feet within generous transparent margins.
Keep the mouth, body and ice-spire drawing unchanged except the minimal attachment adjustments needed for clear six-leg connections. No text, ground, shadow, effects, new anatomy or background. This is still a static appearance proposal, no gameplay collision or ability.
